reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    cur = mx = nums[0]
    for x in nums[1:]:
        cur = max(x, cur + x)
        mx = max(mx, cur)
    print(mx)
